about.heading: Four decades of management education, now in Bengaluru
about.body: TAPMI Bengaluru is a constituent unit of Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE), and extends the legacy of T. A. Pai Management Institute to Bengaluru. Our executive education offers open programmes for individuals and customised learning for organisations. We begin with your goals: understanding the business problem or career ambition first, then designing learning that can be applied at work.
about.quote: From functional expert to business leader.
about.quote_context: The idea behind our Executive MBA, and the spirit behind everything we teach.

programmes.name: Executive MBA
programmes.summary: For experienced professionals ready to take on broader business and leadership responsibilities.
programmes.detail_heading: A rigorous, applied pathway for professionals who know their function and want to lead the business.
programmes.who_its_for: Experienced professionals moving towards broader management roles, and organisations developing high-potential managers.
programmes.what_you_gain: Broader business and leadership capability, confidence for the next role, and a peer network of working professionals.
programmes.format: Designed to be compatible with work. Calendar, workload and assessment details are shared during counselling.
programmes.positioning: Choose us when career progression and credibility matter most.

programmes.name: Management Development Programmes
programmes.summary: Customised programmes that turn a specific business challenge into organisational capability.
programmes.detail_heading: Don’t train around the problem. Build capability around it.
programmes.who_its_for: Organisations with a clear capability gap, such as AI adoption, leadership transition, transformation or succession, and a sponsor who can define outcomes.
programmes.how_we_work: Diagnose, co-design, deliver experientially, then evaluate outcomes with you.
programmes.format: On campus, online or hybrid, shaped by your audience and objectives.
programmes.positioning: Choose us when relevance to real decisions matters most.

programmes.name: Management Certifications
programmes.summary: Focused, credible certifications that build skills you can use, not just a certificate to display.
programmes.detail_heading: Build a capability your workforce can use, not just a certificate they can display.
programmes.who_its_for: Early-to-mid career professionals seeking a credible skill upgrade, and organisations upskilling teams at scale.
programmes.what_you_gain: Skills demonstrated through assessment and applied work, backed by management-school rigour.
programmes.format: Modular and targeted, without the commitment of a full degree.
programmes.positioning: Choose us when you need proof of capability, not just content.

faqs.question: How do I choose between the three pathways?
faqs.answer: Choose the Executive MBA for a broader leadership transition, an MDP to solve an organisational challenge, and a certification for a specific skill.

faqs.question: Can my organisation sponsor me?
faqs.answer: Yes. Organisations can sponsor participants. Tell us in the enquiry form and our team will discuss options.

faqs.question: Will the programme fit alongside work?
faqs.answer: Our programmes are designed for working professionals. Calendar, workload and format details are shared during your conversation with the team.

faqs.question: Where can I find fees and dates?
faqs.answer: Fees and schedules are confirmed per programme. Please enquire, and check the official TAPMI website for the latest information.
